tasks.label: Start Frontend (Vite)
tasks.command: powershell -Command "if (-not (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { npm run dev } else { Write-Host 'Local: http://localhost:8080/ (already running)' }"

tasks.label: Start Backend (FastAPI)
tasks.command: powershell -Command "if (-not (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 } else { Write-Host 'Application startup complete. (Already running on port 8000)' }"
